quote.quote: NDA 205123 was presented before the Antiviral Drugs Advisory Committee.
The Advisory Committee (AC) meeting was held on October 24, 2013. The following questions were discussed at the AC meeting:

recommendation.text: The committee voted 19 Yes / 0 No / 0 Abstain in favor of approval of simeprevir in combination with pegylated interferon and ribavirin for HCV genotype 1 infection.

quote.quote: On the question of whether the available data support the approval of simeprevir for treatment of HCV genotype 1 infection in combination with pegylated interferon and ribavirin the committee voted 19 Yes; 0 No; 0 Abstain.

linkages.concern: The committee discussed whether a separate warning for rash (distinct from photosensitivity) should be added to the prescribing information; a broad range of opinions were expressed, with some members favoring two distinct warnings.
linkages.change: After the AC discussion, DAVP proposed adding a separate Warnings and Precautions statement for rash to the simeprevir label, in addition to the photosensitivity warning.

concern_quote.quote: Some committee members thought it might be confusing to have two separate warnings for photosensitivity and rash; while others thought it would be better to have two distinct warnings.

change_quote.quote: After discussion with the Advisory Committee, DAVP will propose a separate Warning for rash in the prescribing information for simeprevir, as follows:

linkages.concern: The committee was asked whether photosensitivity reactions and a recommendation for sun-protection measures should be included in the Warnings and Precautions section; the committee agreed they should be.
linkages.change: The applicant had not proposed including photosensitivity in the label; DAVP added a Warnings and Precautions statement on photosensitivity, including avoidance of sun exposure and use of sun protective measures.

concern_quote.quote: The committee agreed that photosensitivity reactions and sun-protection measures should be included in the Warnings and Precautions section of simeprevir prescribing information.

change_quote.quote: The Applicant had not proposed including Photosensitivity and/or Rash in this section. In light of the association of photosensitivity and rash with simeprevir in the clinical trials, DAVP proposed the following language:

linkages.concern: The committee was asked about managing reduced efficacy in patients with the baseline NS3 Q80K polymorphism; the committee generally agreed with DAVP's plan to recommend screening genotype 1a patients for Q80K and considering alternative treatment options.
linkages.change: The simeprevir labeling strongly recommends screening HCV genotype 1a patients for the NS3 Q80K polymorphism at baseline and considering alternative therapy for those with the polymorphism.

concern_quote.quote: In general, the committee agreed with DAVP's plan to recommend screening for the Q80K polymorphism.

change_quote.quote: Screening patients with HCV genotype 1a infection for the presence of virus with the NS3 Q80K polymorphism at baseline is strongly recommended.

summary: An Antiviral Drugs Advisory Committee meeting was held on October 24, 2013 for NDA 205123 (simeprevir/Olysio), where the committee voted 19 Yes / 0 No / 0 Abstain that the data support approval in combination with pegylated interferon and ribavirin for HCV genotype 1. The committee's advice on cutaneous safety is explicitly tied in the Cross-Discipline Team Leader review to DAVP's decision to add a separate Warnings and Precautions statement for rash, and the committee also endorsed including a photosensitivity warning and screening genotype 1a patients for the Q80K polymorphism, both of which appear in the final labeling. The verbatim AdComm transcript is not in paperclip; these facts come from the FDA review documents' account of the meeting.
